name: DNA Helix
description: A 3D ASCII double helix: colour-coded A-T and G-C base pairs twist in perspective as the strand scrolls and sways, with free nucleotides drifting behind it. Every so often a replication fork travels down the helix, unzipping it and zipping it back together.
author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

params.label: Zoom Level
params.description: How close the camera sits to the helix.

params.label: Palette
params.description: Color scheme used to draw the base pairs.
